title: Day six: screenshots

beats.say: Day six of the shop. We got thirty seven orders. Start packing.
beats.show: Day 6 of the shop. We got 37 orders. Start packing.

beats.say: Thirty seven screenshots. All marked paid. Packing.
I wrote each buyer a thank you note. About four hundred words each.
beats.show: I wrote each buyer a thank you note. About 400 words each.

beats.say: Wait! Screenshots can be edited. I checked your actual bank app.

screen.title: Mitti
screen.body:
Orders: 37
Paid: 1

1. A screenshot is not proof. It can be edited.
2. Ship only when the money shows in YOUR bank or UPI app.
3. Use your own QR. Never scan one a buyer sends.

beats.say: One real payment. Ship only when the money shows in your own bank app.

caption:
37 orders. 37 payment screenshots. 1 actual payment, and it was from mum.

a payment screenshot can be edited in a minute. ship only when the money shows in your own bank or UPI app history, and never scan a QR code a buyer sends you. to receive money, you never scan or enter your PIN.

how do you check a payment: screenshot or bank app?

Comment SCAM and I'll DM you the 3 step payment check for sellers and the polite reply to send when a buyer only has a screenshot.
